integrity: Exact formulas and proof with standalone finite-field corroboration; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the specified power-sum genus-four curve in every finite field of characteristic at least seven; it does not cover twists, exceptional smaller characteristics, the complete curve zeta function or independently verified priority.
title: Uniform reduced Weierstrass support and Frobenius descent on Bring's genus-four curve
